title: The rule of lenity
summary: Lenity resolves qualifying ambiguity in a criminal prohibition or penalty in the defendant’s favor.
notes: Katzmann lists lenity among private-right canons and reports that the Tenth Circuit invoked it when excluding foreign convictions in a sentencing-enhancement context discussed alongside Gayle. It reflects concern about imposing criminal consequences under unclear legislative instructions.
